root: Uni-CLI 0.227.1 is the corrected publication target for this release line; the 0.227.0 candidate stopped before npm and GitHub Release publication when its gate found host-contaminated tests.
All Node HTTP execution now has one proxy owner: fetch and dispatcher come from the same Undici package across pipelines, OAuth, downloads, extraction, cascade, and the public HTTP transport.
Repair is now a bounded exact-command verifier with no hidden npm, git, or agent mutation; envelope truth, oracle evidence, and process exit code agree.

Live cookies remain in memory unless explicitly exported, and the canonical release gate now proves Node 22/24 Linux, Windows, macOS, dependency-audit, repair, and portable test-inventory truth before publication.
zh: Uni-CLI 0.227.1 是这一发布线修正后的发布目标；0.227.0 候选在门禁发现受宿主环境污染的测试后，已于 npm 与 GitHub Release 发布前停止。
全部 Node HTTP 执行现在都由同一代理边界负责：pipeline、OAuth、download、extract、cascade 与公共 HTTP transport 的 fetch 和 dispatcher 均来自同一 Undici 包。
repair 现在是有界的原命令 verifier，不再隐藏执行 npm、git 或 agent mutation；envelope、oracle evidence 与 process exit code 表达同一真值。
实时 cookie 默认只留在内存；统一 release gate 会在发布前验证 Node 22/24 Linux、Windows、macOS、依赖审计、repair 与跨平台测试清单真值。
